system.description:
ALIGNED

For a moment the mortal shape inherited from your parents gives way to something much older.
Action 1 AP
Duration 1 minute
You partially manifest the Eternal ancestry within you. Your appearance changes dramatically: luminous wings may appear without physical substance, geometric sigils may crawl across your body, your shadow may move independently, or your features may become impossibly symmetrical or disturbing.
For the duration, your weapon and unarmed attacks are treated as Magical and gain your aligned trait. Once per round, the first time you inflict HP damage upon a creature, you inflict an additional 1d6 secondary aligned damage matching your heritage. A Balance-Blooded character inflicts Essence damage instead.
You also gain the following benefit according to your heritage:
Balance You gain Immunity to Mental damage.
Chaos You are immune to the Stunned condition.
Evil You are immune to Poison and Sleep.
Good You are immune to Disease and Poison.
Order You are immune to Confusion and Fear.
Lightwoven and Seraphel characters use the Good benefit.

Prerequisites Level 15, Eternal Resonance

Use (1 AP; the book prints no frequency): a one-minute effect — the aligned immunity for your heritage on your defences, the +1d6 secondary damage as a strike rider (once a round, any Strike), Magical attacks a note.
